name: hasCertificatesManagedExternally
definition: True when every outbound trust certificate object a managed firewall's rulestack uses points to a key held in an external secrets manager rather than stored in the firewall service.
population: outbound trust certificate objects of the rulestacks used by the managed firewalls; denominator = every certificate object read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of every such certificate object, each with a running signer reference that is a secrets-manager secret.
citations: Public OpenAPI reference for Cloud NGFW for AWS, pan.dev openapi-specs/cloudngfw/aws (ManageNGFW, ManageRulestacks, ManageCertificateObjects), rendered at https://pan.dev/cloudngfw/aws/api/

changeLog.change: Registered so the Cloud NGFW transform can emit it. Meaning written from the public reference only; no customer read, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Written for the AWS flavour, where the signer is an AWS Secrets Manager reference. Whether other tools should answer this key is not ruled. A certificate answer with no signer reference is not measured (the reference does not say absent means held elsewhere), never false.
